proofs.actual: Frozen Task, Node, and TaskGroup legal transitions pass; illegal transitions throw before mutation.
Exactly 23 public operations are exposed; no WorkItem, Claim, Lease, or alternate scheduler surface exists.
Same binding is safe, different binding conflicts, and startNode resolves the stored opaque workerRef without caller selection.
Runtime validation, actorRef, idempotencyKey, expected versions, deterministic replay, fingerprint conflict, and stale zero-write paths pass.
Reopen preserves execution history, bindings, documents, and events; increments runNo; clears current-run worker; resets later nodes; and re-resolves the same binding.
Node context contains declared input metadata only; missing output blocks completion; Markdown hash/index and injected DB failure reconciliation use real files and SQLite.
maxActiveTasks=1 and ACTIVE/WAITING/FAILED/PAUSED blocking are enforced; success releases the next Task through owner-computed eligibility.

Canonical documentType is owner-mapped to a safe relative Markdown path; absolute target and traversal-like documentType are rejected; replacement is temp-write, file fsync, rename, and directory fsync.
Fresh real SQLite contains 9 business tables plus schema_migrations, required foreign keys, checks, uniqueness, and indexes.
Injected transaction failure rolls back; SQL version compare-and-update rejects stale writes without replacing the committed row.
Public repository ports expose domain records and transaction/read only; no SQL prepare/exec/connection or SQLite row crosses the port.
journal_mode=wal, busy_timeout=2500, integrity_check=ok, foreign keys enabled, and close/reopen retains full happy-path facts.
Two real connections observe one unique idempotency row; duplicate insert conflicts; domain same/same replay and same/different fingerprint paths are deterministic.
Discovery sorts versions [1,2] deterministically and rejects duplicate or invalid metadata.
Second apply is empty; malformed migration rolls back only its transaction and stops before later versions; corrected re-entry recovers and verifies.
Fresh and sequential upgrades report identical applied versions and identical introspected actual schemas; interrupted re-entry converges and integrity verifies.
apply/status/verify and machine JSON CLI are public execution primitives; schema SQL is imported from task-store-sqlite/migrations.
